headline: Blue Origin advertises TeraWave AMS co-simulation methodology and behavioral-model infrastructure
fact: Blue Origin advertised TeraWave AMS Design Verification Engineer R65544 to lead mixed-mode verification methodology. The role defines the co-simulation EDA environment with analog and digital teams, creates Verilog/SystemVerilog testbenches and analog/mixed-signal behavioral models, and develops block- and chip-level verification methods. An August 21 recruiting-board copy predates the current official Workday September 15 date. The earlier retained public posting dates this Event; the role establishes a hiring mandate for model and verification infrastructure, without an assigned AI-verification task.
